note: Motion DNA presets as portable recipes, exported from the After Effects engine by research/platforms/export_portable.jsx. Each phase (in/out) is a list of segments: channel, start_f and frames (at 30 fps, from the phase start), from/to relative to the layer's rest value (position and anchor: pixel offsets, y down; rotation: degrees; scale and opacity: fractions), and the curve: ease (a token in tokens/superside_motion_tokens.json), bezier (cubic-bezier), stops (several token segments) or ae (After Effects influence/speed). ae_only lists what a preset animates that only After Effects has (effects, masks, text).
